answer: A concrete Sybil defense is per-identity bond escrow with cluster-wide slashing. Each agent must lock collateral before it can earn payouts or carry weight, so a thousand sockpuppets need a thousand real deposits up front. If any node is caught coordinating, the entire linked cluster forfeits, a thread of accountability the attacker cannot walk back. Every new identity is an ember of sunk cost instead of free weight, and the cost curve becomes a glacier: slow, heavy, unable to melt into liquidity. The honest operator pays once to enter; the sybil pays to enter and to exit.
